title: Rig Inspection Method Statement
description: Free Rig Inspection Method Statement template for oil & gas you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers rig information, 3.0 daily inspection checklist, 4.0 weekly inspection checklist.

1.0 SCOPE: This procedure covers systematic inspection of all drilling rig equipment and systems.

2.0 RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Toolpusher: Overall inspection coordination • Driller: Floor & rotary equipment

• Chief Mechanic: Engines, pumps, mechanical systems • Chief Electrician: Electrical systems

• Safety Officer: Safety equipment, alarms, PPE • Third-party inspectors (as required)

7.0 Critical Item Inspection Procedure

7.1 Drill Line Inspection:

• Inspect for broken wires (max 6 per lay)

• Check for birdcaging, crushing, or kinks

• Measure diameter reduction (max 5%)

• Check lubrication condition

• Record ton-miles and slip/ cut program

7.2 BOP Stack Inspection:

• Visual inspection for damage, corrosion

• Check all bolts/ fasteners torque

• Verify ram type and size for current operation

• Inspect choke and kill lines for erosion

• Check all hydraulic connections

7.3 Traveling Equipment Inspection:

• Inspect traveling block sheaves

• Check hook condition and latch

• Inspect elevator links and ears

• Verify top drive swivel and IBOP function
